content: Namwa Mona Enenge PalyuoKararama Doko
Yangonemoo, nakama lowa dokona singi dokome pii langiru doko serami ingilyamo. Lowa dokome akali lete karelyamo yuu gii dokopa baa keta palenge.
Enda akali nyingi dokona makande pyuo pii mende leto. Doko akalingi doko lete karelyamo dokopa baa anjisi petenge lao lowana letamo. Akali kumaramo dokopa baa kapa para.

Enda mende akalingi lete kararamopa akali mendepa role pyara ramo dokona baa pamuku enda ingilyamo larami. Dee banya akalingi kumaparamo akali mende nyera ramo doko baa kepo pirasa pii nara. Lowa doko baa enda waiya dokome akali wakale kapa nyera letamo.

Yangonemoo, pii doko nakama keta palamo. Nakama Yesu Koraisana yanenge dokona pingyasi karaminyi dokona lao Lowa dokome nakama minyaro sulu see nalyamo. Yesu kumapala lopo epeya doko baapa pakao karo Anatunya yulu rolae dupwa piramasa pira.
Namwa mee yanengena yulu pyuo kareyamano dokopa yulu koo pinya suu pingi dupwa koo renge dokome Lowa minyapala namwana yanenge dupwana kata papyuo kareya. Dokome kumungi renge andanyi pyambuya.
Lowame namwa puu maiyamo kareyamanopape epapu moko nyisi karamano. Dokona lao lowa letamuli pyuo kararamande daa. Imambunya kata enenge dokona pyuo kararama.
Lowape Dee Koona Rengepe Pii Dolapo

Dokona lao apa laramase? Lowa angi doko kooŋo laramase? Ama daa. Lowa dokome koo dokoŋo lao lasaka piya. Lowame wambu yangona bange awuapala nyipuli nyipuli yaka lao suu pyaa napipi laa nayali doko nyipuli nyipuli yaka lao suu pingi kata dokona lao soo pakana palya nayoli.

Dopa piyamopape yulu doo dokome lowa palengena kata doko kando nyiya. Dokona piso nyipuli nyipuli lao suu pingi wakale wakale dupwa nambana monarena epenge. Lowa see nayali doko koo doko kumuo isa peyali.
Lowa namba keta pali nayamo dokopa namba lete ingyuo kareyo. Enakana Lowa pii pyasi palamo doko epapeyamo dokopa koo doko ando nyimbuya. Dopa pyuo koo doko ando sipureyamo dokopa namba kumuyu.
Lowana pii pyasi palamo doko lete parami laminyipape namba keta kumungi renge jiya.
Koona renge dokome lowana kata kando nyepala namba keta panga soo epo lowana pii dokome namba pyao kumakaya.
Lowa angi doko poo pyasi. Dee pii lowa dokona pyasi palamo doko poo pyasioko doko rolae keyangepe ingyuo silyamo.

Pii doko apa lao letase? Keyange dokome namba pyao kumakayase? Ama daa. Koona renge dokome lowana alya minyuo namba pyao kumakaya. Pyao kumakapala dokopa koona renge angi doko paneya. Dokona lao koo renge dokome lowana pyasi palamo doko nyepala koo wakasa ingyuo andalu ando andelyamo.
Yulu Koo Dokome Namwana Suu Pingi Puu Mailyamo
Lowa doko Imambunya ingyuo silyamo lao silyamano. Dopa pipyamopape namba mee isa akali karo dokona koo dokome namba karapusi pipyamopa karo.
Apa pyuo pilyu lao see napunupa mee pyuoko pelyo. Nambame keyange pinya suu pyapunu kata dokona papu pilyu. Papu pipala pii nalana suu pyapunu dupwanako pyuo pelyo.
Pii nalana lao suu pyapu doko pyuo karo dokopa Lowa kata doko rolaeŋe lao lasaka pilyamo lao silyu.
Yulu koo dupwa namba rangeme sisu lao pilyunde daa. Koona renge namba keta palipala dokome pilyamo lao silyu.
Namba isa akali dokome namba keta keyange mende pali nalyamo lao silyu. Nambame keyange doko pipuli pipuli lao sipunupape pinya saka nalyo.
Namba keyange piru lao suu pyapu doko papu pilyu. Papu pipala yulu koo pii nalana suu pyapu dokona pipa pilyu.
Pii nalana suu pilyu dokona piru ramo doko nambame sisu lao pilyunde daa. Koonde namba keta palamo dokome pipyasa pilyamo lao silyu.
Namba keta koo renge palamo doko soo gisilyu. Doko yulu keyange pinya lao suu pyapunupape yulu koo dokona namba sinyi palyapa pilyamo.
Kinyi nambana mona andarena Anatunya lowa doko mona retelyo.

Dopa pipunupape lowa wakale mendeme nambana yanenge dokona keta palamo lao silyu. Lowa wakalendeme lowa namba mona retelyamo doko yanda pimwai ingilyamo. Dakepa lowa koo dokome yanengena yulu pilyamo silyu dokome namba puu maipyamo karo.
Namba rae mai nalyo. Doko aki akalinde karose? Nambana yanenge kumara doko namba puu jilyamo. Apimi namba kiiramo nyerase?

Anatumi namwana Kamongo Yesu Koraisa keta kiiramo nyiyamosa dokona baa kando sangyu leto. Namba dopale ingyuo karo lao langiru. Nambame Anatunya lowa doko suu pingi dokome iki mee ketae pilyu. Dopa pyuo pipala yanengena yulu dokome koona renge kata dokona pelyo.
